description.en: Coastal hydrochemistry analysis, flux estimation step: Calculates daily, monthly, and annual river constituent fluxes using daily chemistry and discharge data.

variables.title: Variables
variables.description: List of variable names to process.

variable_units.title: Variable units
variable_units.description: List of variable=unit pairs giving the unit of each variable.

non_mass_vars.title: Non-mass variables
non_mass_vars.description: List of variables that do not represent mass concentrations (e.g. Color, UV_Abs_254nm, UV_Abs_410nm). Their discharge-related outputs are treated as qualitative proxies and must not be interpreted as actual mass loads or fluxes.

url_discharge.title: Discharge input
url_discharge.description: URL of the input river discharge file.

river_name.title: River name
river_name.description: River for which fluxes are estimated.

discharge_station_name.title: Discharge station name
discharge_station_name.description: Name of the discharge gauging station to select from the discharge file.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Latitude of the location in decimal degrees (-90 to 90).

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Longitude of the location in decimal degrees (-180 to 180).

url_interpolated_waterchem.title: Interpolated chemistry input
url_interpolated_waterchem.description: URL of daily interpolated river water-chemistry NetCDF file.

flux_date_col.title: Interpolated chemistry date column
flux_date_col.description: Name of the date coordinate or column used during river flux estimation. Default: date.

flux_station_col.title: Station column
flux_station_col.description: Name of the station or river identifier column used during river flux estimation. Default: river_name.

flux_discharge_col.title: Discharge column
flux_discharge_col.description: Name of the river-discharge variable or column used during flux estimation. Default: discharge.

monthly_flux.title: Monthly flux NetCDF
monthly_flux.description: Monthly constituent flux estimates, aggregated from daily estimates.

annual_flux.title: Annual flux NetCDF
annual_flux.description: Annual constituent flux estimates, aggregated from daily estimates.
